content.description: Socket wrench being used to remove bearing retainer from alternator front housing

items: (a) Remove the four screws and bearing retainer.
(b) Using a press and socket wrench, press out the front bearing.

content.description: SST tool being used to press in front bearing into alternator drive end frame

content.text: (c) Using SST, install the front bearing into the drive end frame.
(d) Install the bearing retainer with the four screws.

content.description: Hands inspecting rear bearing of alternator rotor shaft

content.text: Check that the rear bearing is not rough or worn. Replace if necessary.

content.description: SST tool being used to remove rear bearing with bearing cover from rotor shaft

content.text: (a) Using SST, remove the rear bearing with the bearing cover from the rotor shaft.
CAUTION: Be careful not to damage the fan.

content.description: SST tool being used with press to install rear bearing and bearing cover onto rotor shaft

content.text: (b) Using SST and a press, press in the rear bearing and bearing cover onto the rotor shaft.
